newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH NOV TRADE DATA DUE TODAY AT NOON -NCB.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH NOV TRADE DATA DUE TODAY AT NOON -NCB.

text.p: Finnish November foreign trade data will be published today on Tuesday at 1200/1000 GMT, the National Customs Board (NCB) said in a statement on Tuesday.
In October, the trade surplus was 2.35 billion markka for a 10-month total of 35.3 billion markka, NCB said earlier.
The Bank of Finland's estimate for the November trade surplus was 5.6 billion markka with exports at 17.9 billion markka and imports at 12.3 billion.
